audit.whatIsWrong: Early text blames the proxy but omits the actual lane-losing mechanic: Mega Adhesive (W) grounds, which disables both Shuriken Flip and Perfect Execution.
audit.why: Grounding is the single interaction that decides whether Akali can commit or escape, and it was absent from every stage.
audit.corrected: Early/mid text now names Fling (E) at 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s and Mega Adhesive (W) at 17/16/15/14/13s as the two cooldowns the lane is played around.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 spike told you to bait 'the W fling' — wrong slot — and gave no reason the R window can fail.
audit.why: Perfect Execution is a dash; started on Mega Adhesive it does not fire at all, so the stated kill window was unreliable as written.
audit.corrected: Level 6 and first-item spikes now key the commit to Fling being down and to standing off his adhesive.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fling was called 'W fling' throughout the content layer; Mega Adhesive's grounding, the Fling-into-adhesive root, and Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds were all missing.
audit.why: Riot's kit file puts Fling on E and Mega Adhesive on W; Fling's own text states the root when the target lands in adhesive; Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.
audit.corrected: All slots relabelled; added that Twilight Shroud makes Akali unselectable so the target-locked Fling cannot be cast on her, that grounding denies E and R, that Fling into adhesive roots, and that Insanity Potion anti-heals your Gunblade drain.

edits.before: Singed proxies behind your tower and never stands to trade, so your Q kunai poke hits nothing and you bleed XP while he farms your wave. With no Shroud yet, chasing him into his poison trail just lets him W-fling you back into the minions and walk off on move speed.
edits.after: Singed proxies behind your tower and never stands to trade, so your Q kunai poke hits nothing and you bleed XP while he farms your wave. With no Shroud yet, chasing him into Poison Trail just lets him Fling (E) you back into the minions — and land in Mega Adhesive and you are rooted.

edits.before: Perfect Execution is your one clean window: E-flip onto him, R-dash through, then second-cast the missing-health execute before his base sustain and poison tick the damage back. Bait the W fling first — if it's on cooldown, that's your green light to commit.
edits.after: Perfect Execution is your one clean window: E-flip on, R-dash through, then second-cast the missing-health execute before Poison Trail ticks the damage back. Bait Fling (E) first — it is down 10s at rank 1 — and never start on Mega Adhesive: grounded, your E and R dashes both fail.

edits.before: Gunblade/Lich Bane spike lets your single combo nearly delete him IF you catch Flash down and drop W-Shroud to dodge the fling. Miss the all-in and he out-sustains it, because Singed only needs to survive your energy bar to win the trade.
edits.after: Gunblade/Lich Bane lets one combo nearly delete him IF you catch Flash down and drop Twilight Shroud — Fling is target-locked, so it cannot be cast on you inside the smoke. Miss the all-in and he out-sustains it; Singed only needs to survive your energy bar.

edits.before: Singed's window — Rylai drain-tank means his W fling plus a permaslow chains you while his poison out-heals your single-target burst. He proxy-splits the map and you have no way to body-block a champion that's untargetable-fast and immune to your one CC.
edits.after: Singed's window — Rylai drain-tank means Fling plus a permaslow chains you while his poison out-heals your single-target burst. Insanity Potion puts Grievous Wounds on that poison too, so your Gunblade drain stops mattering the moment his 100s R is up.

edits.before: Save W-Shroud for the all-in, not the poke — go untargetable to dodge the W fling and break his move-speed chase rather than burning it to farm safely
edits.after: Save Twilight Shroud for the all-in — unselectable inside it, you cannot be Flung at all, so spend it on his commit rather than to farm safely

edits.before: Wait for Level 6 R to gap-close and execute him in one window, before his base sustain and poison tick your burst damage back to full
edits.after: Wait for Level 6 R to gap-close and execute in one window — start it off his Mega Adhesive, because grounded your R dash will not fire

edits.before: Catch him with Flash down, E-flip on, and Gunblade/Lich Bane combo before he reaches a wave to W-fling-reset and kite away
edits.after: Catch him with Flash down, E-flip on, and Gunblade/Lich Bane combo before he reaches a wave to Fling (E) you off and kite away

edits.before: W-fling you into his poison trail and minions, then kite off on move speed while the poison ticks you down
edits.after: Fling (E) you into Mega Adhesive for the root, then kite off on move speed while Poison Trail ticks you down

edits.before: He W-flings you into the poison trail and minions and kites off on move speed while you still have no escape tool pre-6.
edits.after: He Flings (E) you into Mega Adhesive — that pairing roots you — then kites off on move speed while you have no escape pre-6.

edits.before: With all three basics you can W-Shroud the fling and the poison chase, but he has zero fear of you and you have no kill pressure — it's a coinflip on who commits.
edits.after: With all three basics Twilight Shroud denies the target-locked Fling entirely, but he has zero fear of you and you have no kill pressure — it's a coinflip on who commits.

edits.before: Rylai drain-tank Singed out-sustains your single-target combo and permaslows your E commit — his poison and fling run you down all game.
edits.after: Rylai drain-tank Singed out-sustains your combo, and Mega Adhesive grounds your E and R outright — poison plus Fling runs you down all game.

edits.before: Don’t chase poison — shroud his fling, E-Q close. Akali wins the Fling cooldown windows.
edits.after: Don't chase poison — Shroud denies Fling (E). Never commit while standing on Mega Adhesive.

edits.before: Shroud his fling and burst him. Track Fling before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Shroud denies Fling; burst him off his Mega Adhesive. Track both cooldowns and hold the wave near you.

edits.before: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Only take the trade when Singed's Fling is down.
edits.after: Shroud makes target-locked Fling uncastable. Trade when it is down, 10s at rank 1.

edits.before: - Singed Fling: matchup-defining — His flip. Shroud-dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Singed Fling (E), 10s at rank 1: Shroud denies it outright. - Mega Adhesive, 17s: grounds your E and R — never fight on it. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: His flip. Shroud-dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Fling (E) is 10s at rank 1. Shroud denies it. Engage once it is down.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Fling into Mega Adhesive roots you, and grounded your dashes fail.

notes: Content layer consistently labelled Fling as W; Riot's kit puts Fling on E and Mega Adhesive on W. Mega Adhesive's grounding (denies Shuriken Flip and Perfect Execution) was absent everywhere and is the decisive interaction.
